$comment: Decision record (task P3.1, C12, T4.3): one analysis decision, who made it (a person or an agent), what had been seen when it was made, which artifacts it produced and which recipe it chose. 'seen' binds a prefix of the analysis's exposure record (through_seq entries and the canonical SHA-256 of exactly those entries), so the binding survives later appends and an edited history is detected. A decision record authorizes nothing; it is lineage.

through_seq.$comment: number of exposure-record entries that existed when the decision was made

entries_sha256.$comment: canonical SHA-256 of those entries (a JSON list)

recipe_sha256.$comment: canonical SHA-256 of the recipe the decision chose or ran under, when there is one
